summary: StepMania entries track the open-source rhythm-engine baseline and the fork/song-pack-dependent preservation problem around dance-game simulation.

entries.title: StepMania
entries.definitive_edition: Documented StepMania 5.x desktop build plus explicitly sourced/local song pack

emulation.notes: Native desktop engine; timing requires display/audio/input calibration.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native desktop build with calibrated input and documented song pack

primary.version: StepMania 5.1 branch or documented current official build with local song pack
primary.why: StepMania is an open-source rhythm-game engine rather than a fixed commercial song package. Archive fidelity depends on exact build, theme, input device, noteskin and simfile/song pack; the official desktop build is the baseline, while forks such as ITGmania or OutFox should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use a documented StepMania build on desktop. Record build/version, OS, theme, noteskin, pad/keyboard/controller, timing/calibration, refresh rate, song pack provenance/license, chart difficulty, modifiers, judgment window, and whether a fork was used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only as labeled comparison or separate entries.
secondary.why: They can change timing, feature support, online services, and content expectations.

all_releases.reason: primary: canonical archive route when build and content are documented.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern official-branch desktop route with version-specific behavior.
all_releases.reason: primary: use only with exact version recorded.

all_releases.fidelity: Fork-specific features, timing and content ecosystems.
all_releases.reason: secondary: comparison only unless intentionally archiving that fork.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no single fixed content-complete edition; build, simfiles, input latency and licensing define the captured experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not bundle unsourced copyrighted simfiles into the recommendation. Record exact build and content source.
